name: STORM_TOSSED_SHIP
canonical: a small ancient single-masted wooden merchant sailing vessel pitching steeply on heaving black storm waves, its lone square sail torn and straining, hull awash and spray flying. An old-world plank-built boat in a tempest — NOT a modern yacht or steamship, NOT a calm sea
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
